name: Lid awake
description: A rail button that keeps the Mac awake even with the lid closed (pmset disablesleep), on and off with one click. Lets go on a low battery; survives Gerdr restarting itself.

settings.title: Animated icons
settings.description: For moving pictures from sprite add-ons (Pixel Clawd walks); built-in icons stay still.

settings.title: Let go at battery
settings.description: On battery at or under this, the Mac may sleep again (it comes back once plugged in). 0 = never.

settings.title: Authorize
settings.label: Authorize
settings.description: Installs a sudoers rule allowing only pmset disablesleep 1 / 0; you enter your password once on this computer. Not needed if Gerdr's Labs or Amphetamine already did.

zh.name: 合盖不休眠
zh.description: rail 上一个按钮，点一下让 Mac 合上盖子也不睡（pmset disablesleep），再点一下关。电量低时自动放手；Gerdr 自己重启时不会断。

lowBattery.title: 电量低于多少放手
lowBattery.description: 用电池且电量 ≤ 这个数时不再挡着睡眠（插上电自动回来）。0 = 一直不放手。

authorize.title: 授权
authorize.label: 授权
authorize.description: 装一条 sudoers 规则，只放行 pmset disablesleep 1 / 0；在电脑上输一次密码。Gerdr 实验室或 Amphetamine 已经授权过就不用。

animate.title: 动态图标
animate.description: 素材扩展里会动的图（比如像素 Clawd 会走路）；内置图标不动。
